Angled green preview

Back to app

Three fixed examples to review before adding angled greens to normal play. Your shots and progress are not saved here.

Tap to choose direction, then set carry. The bird’s-eye view is available throughout this geometry preview so you can inspect the outline.

Current illustrative shot profiles and scoring assumptions are unchanged. Front/back are the edges along the ball-to-green-center line; they are not the nearest and farthest points anywhere on the green. This preview does not introduce putting slopes or elevation physics.
